hooks.hook_text: ShipBob just rolled out its Simulation Terminal to every sandbox account, letting merchants run full‑cycle fulfillment, receiving, and inventory adjustments without touching a real warehouse.

hooks.hook_text: ShipBob’s Spring 2026 release introduced the ‘ShipBob Promise’ delivery‑date engine that surfaces precise delivery dates to shoppers, aiming to boost conversion.
